argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $r=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/managed-chats?inspect=1' -TimeoutSec 6; $a=@($r.chats); Write-Output ('FRESH_INSPECTION='+$r.inspected); Write-Output ('REGISTERED='+$a.Count); Write-Output ('STICKY_ENABLED='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.stickySession.enabled -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('STICKY_PRESERVED='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.stickySession.status -eq 'PRESERVED'}).Count); Write-Output ('STICKY_UNPINNED='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.stickySession.status -eq 'UNPINNED'}).Count); Write-Output ('STICKY_OTHER='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.stickySession.enabled -eq $true -and $_.stickySession.status -notin @('PRESERVED','UNPINNED')}).Count); Write-Output ('ONE_TAB='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.openTabs -eq 1}).Count); Write-Output ('HIGH='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.highMode -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('GENERATING='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.generating -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('RATE_LIMITED='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.providerRateLimited -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('DRAFTS='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.draftPresent -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('CONTEXT_EXHAUSTED='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.contextLimit -eq $true}).Count)

note: Read-only live R61 sticky existing-tab epoch/session status counts; do not emit chat identities and do not open/reload/focus/send
